name: Adiel
overview: The name Adiel appears in Scripture as a man associated with the tribe of Simeon and as a priestly figure, highlighting his role within Israel's tribal and religious structure. He is noted as the father of Azmaveth, who was entrusted with overseeing the king's treasures, indicating a legacy of faithful service and responsibility. These references collectively emphasize Adiel's place in the genealogical and administrative records of Israel, demonstrating the continuity of godly leadership and stewardship in the Old Testament.
